'''Provo''' (Japanese: '''ポルト''' ''Porto'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP118|Pursuing a Lofty Goal!]]''.

Provo was the four-time defending champion of the [[Squallville PokéRinger]] competition and planned to reinstate his championship for the current year as well. He competed in the first round against [[Paul]]. Unfortunately, [[Paul's Honchkrow]] was able to defeat his {{p|Dragonite}}, and Provo was therefore knocked out of the competition.
